==The Enigma==
'''[[File:Enigma1.png|thumb|400px]]Inspired by:''' 'All I Needed to Know, I Learned from D&D' in ''Dragon 288''.

Hex 07.08

Connects to: 06.03, 18.10.01 and 19.01.

One of the [[witchways]] or [[merlinburrows]] ([[19.01]]) that leads from the Sunless Sea (18.10.01) forks about a mile below the surface. The lefthand path leads to an open cavern, the center of which is occupied by a basalt slab at least fifty yards high. Strange words are carved around the base of the slab, and people who consider what the stone would look like from a distance realise that it would resemble an enormous bald head.

The head is a site of pilgrimage for adherents of the [[Stern Way]] (06.03), but they claim that the head is absent from their myths and histories.
===Hooks===
*What is a witchway? What are the merlinburrows?
*Who is depicted?
*How was the head created and by whom?
*What is the meaning of the words?
*Is the head really absent from the lore of the Stern Way?
